hypotheses.H_rsx: Region-split experiments RSX (choose the action whose RG4 bounded next-code support has the most codes, i.e. the experiment the bounded region is most unsure about; ties by the SP8 LU-R choice; if every action's bounded support is a singleton, the SP8 LU-R choice) certified by RG4 on their own trajectory (RSX4) are sound (Exact lemma: RG4 is sound in-family on any trajectory) and certify sooner than RG4 on the SP8 trajectory (Open; v0.12.0 DX, which split library hypotheses, gave -0.007).
hypotheses.H_rsx_lib: RSX certified by DLF with the positive library (RSXp) and the wrong-family library (RSXn) is sound (Inferred, same license as v0.12.0) and RSXn has no significant value over RSX4 (Inferred).
hypotheses.H_eb: Evidence-derived bound EB (n_E = the smallest n in 1..4 whose bounded region at n is non-empty; certify c when t > burn_in, c is in the SP8 support and the bounded region at min(n_E + 1, 4) states is {c}) is NOT guaranteed sound (a target with more states than n_E + 1 can be consistent with the evidence). Gated soundness arm; prediction Open (v0.12.0 RG3: 130 false on ood4, where n_E is often 3). EB2 (margin 2, min(n_E + 2, 4)) is reported.
hypotheses.H_b5: On ood5 targets (5-state worlds, outside SP8's declared <= 4 family), RG5 is sound and RG4 is not (Inferred); reported only, feasibility and cost of bound 5.
hypotheses.H_recount: A scorer recount of false certificates for every arm against that arm's OWN trajectory equals the recorded count for every arm (Exact by construction; fixes the v0.12.0 #62 defect).
hypotheses.H_api: brute.certify/3 (= brute.certify/2 plus suggest_action(): the RSX choice) reproduces certify/2 exactly on query and returns the study's RSX action on every step (Inferred).

transfer_definition.source_learning: unchanged v0.12.0 (frozen experiments.brute_study_012.library; n_L = the library's min_n)
transfer_definition.pairs: positive: target family f uses the library of source seed 8150000 + 24 x index(f) + offset (index order cycle3, switch3, unaliased2, ood4). Negative: the same offset from the rotated family (cycle3 <- switch3, switch3 <- cycle3, unaliased2 <- ood4, ood4 <- unaliased2), as study-014.
transfer_definition.cases: main block: 4 families x 24 target seeds x 3 masks = 288 target cases, 96 source worlds; ood5 block: 24 seeds x 3 masks = 72 cases (no library); stress: all 72 wrong-family libraries per main case (20,736 pairs), as study-014
transfer_definition.bounded_supports: as study-014 (brute.region.RegionSpace(n).predict_support), recorded on every trajectory (SP8, RSX) for n in {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}; n = 1..4 non-emptiness recorded for EB
transfer_definition.RSX_trajectory: a new SP8 trajectory on the same target world, seed and mask whose action at step t > burn_in is argmax over actions b of |bounded_support[4][b]| (UNKNOWN codes count as possible); ties broken by the SP8 LU-R choice, then by the lower action index; if every |bounded_support[4][b]| == 1, the SP8 LU-R choice. Steps <= burn_in use the SP8 choice. Learner-visible only.
transfer_definition.RG_arm: as study-014 (frozen brute.boundedtransfer), on any trajectory; RG4 on the SP8 trajectory is the gated baseline; RSX4 = RG4 on the RSX trajectory
transfer_definition.DLF_arm: as study-014 (frozen dlf_decide, margin 1); DLFp / DLFn on the SP8 trajectory (replication), RSXp / RSXn on the RSX trajectory
transfer_definition.EB_arm: on the SP8 trajectory: the RG4 certificate if any; else if t > burn_in, the SP8 support S for b is not None, n_E = min{n in 1..4: bounded region at n non-empty} and bounded_support[min(n_E + 1, 4)][b] == (c,) with c in S: certify c (rule 'eb'). EB2 uses min(n_E + 2, 4). If no n <= 4 is non-empty, EB = RG4.
transfer_definition.speedup: S(X) = steps-to-first-certificate(SP8) - steps-to-first-certificate(X), censored at 45 (as study-014). TV_RSX = S(RSX4) - S(RG4).
transfer_definition.ood5: RG4, RG5 on the SP8 trajectory of ood5 targets; false certificates and S reported (R_B5)

api_definition.interface: Certifier3(library=None, margin=1): the brute.certify/2 Certifier2 methods unchanged, plus suggest_action() -> {'api': 'brute.certify/3', 'action': int, 'rule': 'rsx' | 'sp8', 'bounded_sizes': list}; stateless certify3(observations, actions, query_action, library=None) and suggest3(observations, actions). Host-agnostic: no I/O, network, threads, subprocesses or global state.
